about_the_game:
Adds a pack of background music from previous "Atelier" series games that can be used to change the in-game BGM.
Includes a selection of over 1,000 songs from "Atelier" series titles ranging from "Atelier Marie: The Alchemist of Salburg" to "Atelier Sophie 2: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Dream".

Note:
- BGM tracks can be used by selecting "Change BGM" on the save menu.
- Please check the official site for details.
